drafts.title: Nearest Neighbor
drafts.pitch: In the memory archive, Cursor looks up the user's cat and finds a waffle in the drawer, which is a close enough match for Waffles that the user says yes. Writer's pitch, from the waffles candidate.
drafts.reason: The archive setting is new and 'Closest match on file' lands the retrieval gag, but the closer 'You found a waffle.' restates the joke, and the user's yes reads as luck.

drafts.title: The Middle
drafts.pitch: The user asks what they said in the middle of the conversation, and Cursor remembers only the hi and the thanks. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: Clean and compact with a good visual in the fogged middle rows, but 'the middle was the instructions' is a plain reveal with no turn.
